name: Try a Mark
summary: A small experimental identity that encourages material play through forceful titles, plain instructions and a record of attempts.

palette.name: Background
palette.evidence: Native Office page/sheet white ground; explicit design choice retaining the reading surface.

palette.name: Text
palette.evidence: used style Normal explicit text color

palette.name: Print rust
palette.evidence: Native reference.docx word/styles.xml: style ZineLabel; text.

recognitionRules: Use Impact for the short invitation and Courier New for working notes.
Keep each experiment compact enough to fit a zine panel.
Leave space for a printed mark and a short observation.
Show variation across attempts without ranking them as good or bad.
Use rust PRINT LAB labels and black condensed invitations above textured collage examples, with monospaced working notes.

principles: Invite attention before offering interpretation; keep object facts and imaginative response distinct.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Make one mark. Change the pressure. See what the paper tells you.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid prescribing a viewer’s feelings or implying unverified provenance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Look at the edge, then read the record.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use TRY A MARK in Impact with one irregular solid rectangle as a new supporting mark. Keep the rectangle simple enough for one-color printing.
invariants: Use Impact for the short invitation and Courier New for working notes.
Keep each experiment compact enough to fit a zine panel.
Leave space for a printed mark and a short observation.
adaptations: Folded and digital editions retain the experiment order.
The mark can vary by issue while the wordmark remains stable.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Impact is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Courier New is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
